wacky.note: the Senko's dying fall = a slow-falling nymph twitched on the pause

urchin.note: both are craw/creature profiles hopped slowly on the bottom

trig.note: a bottom-dragged worm = a weighted craw stripped slow

jig.note: jig + craw trailer = the same craw profile on the bottom
